title: TEST - Networking Basics
description: Sample question bank for verifying the MongoDB connection.

questions.question: Which OSI layer is responsible for routing?
questions.explanation: Routing happens at Layer 3, the Network layer.

questions.question: Which of these are transport layer protocols?
questions.explanation: TCP and UDP operate at the transport layer; IP is network layer and HTTP is application layer.
